metadata.description: The equanimitech instruments as Claude Code plugins. Each instrument lives in its own repo.

plugins.name: oliba
plugins.description: Agent-native spaced repetition for Claude Code. Map a topic, learn it one piece at a time, and keep it with FSRS reviews and a one-card status-line cue. Grounded in Scott Young's Ultralearning. Local-first, anti-guilt.

plugins.name: zenborg
plugins.description: The garden's Claude Code surface — fences, gap practice, activity log, and garden skills (sunrise, sunset, close-up, recap, tend, season). Local-first, reads the vault you already have.

plugins.name: attently
plugins.description: Adaptive granularity for AI assistants. Sorts every reply by what it costs you to read: the verdict at a glance, the working one click away, unexplored branches only if you ask. Inside cmux, an opt-in ring ranks your Claude sessions against today's priorities so only what needs you reaches you. Blocks nothing.
